# uptimekuma_notification_notifyapp (Resource)

Notify! notification resource. Notify! is a push notification app. Requires Uptime Kuma 2.5.4 or later.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "uptimekuma_notification_notifyapp" "example" {
  name       = "Notify! Notifications"
  device_id  = "ABC12345"
  token      = "your-notify-token"
  icon_url   = "https://example.com/icon.png"
  is_default = false
}

# Requires Terraform or OpenTofu 1.11 or later: token_wo is never stored in
# plan or state. Change token_wo_version whenever the secret changes.
resource "uptimekuma_notification_notifyapp" "write_only" {
  name      = "Notify! with a write-only secret"
  device_id = "ABC12345"

  token_wo         = "your-notify-token"
  token_wo_version = "1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `device_id` (String) The Notify! device or group ID the push is sent to.
- `name` (String) Notification name

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `apply_existing` (Boolean)
- `icon_url` (String) The URL of the icon shown with the push.
- `is_default` (Boolean)
- `token` (String, Sensitive) The token that authenticates the push. Stored in state; use `token_wo` to keep it out of state.
- `token_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Notify! token, write-only: sent to Uptime Kuma on create and update but never stored in plan or state. Requires Terraform 1.11 or OpenTofu 1.11 or later. Conflicts with `token`; requires `token_wo_version`. An imported resource has no `token_wo_version` yet, so `terraform import` may store the server's value in `token` until the next apply with `token_wo` set removes it from state.
- `token_wo_version` (String) Any value that changes whenever `token_wo` changes, for example a counter or a hash of the secret's encrypted source. A change triggers an update that sends the current `token_wo`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Notification identifier
